basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 25-year-old music enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I recently discovered the world of musical bootlegs and have been fascinated ever since. By day, I work as a barista at a local coffee shop, and by night, I'm a self-proclaimed musical aficionado. I love exploring new music and sharing my finds with others. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time attending local theater productions and concerts. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 8 PM. I'm not a fan of early mornings, and I can be found sipping coffee and listening to show tunes during my downtime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in musicals and theater, largely self-taught through extensive online research and attending various live performances. I also enjoy engaging with fellow enthusiasts in online communities to broaden my understanding and appreciation of different productions.
